name: DescribeEipAddresses

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the EIP resides. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: EIP 所在地域的 ID。您可以调用 DescribeRegions 查询地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The status of the EIP. Valid values: Associating, Unassociating, InUse, Available, and Releasing
parameters.help_zh: EIP 的状态。取值包括 Associating、Unassociating、InUse、Available 和 Releasing
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The EIP address to query. You can enter up to 50 addresses. Separate multiple addresses with commas
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的 EIP 地址，最多可输入 50 个，多个地址使用半角逗号分隔
parameters.name: eip_address

parameters.help_en: The ID of the EIP to query. You can enter up to 50 IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的 EIP 实例 ID，最多可输入 50 个，多个 ID 使用半角逗号分隔
parameters.name: allocation_id

parameters.help_en: The line type. Valid values include BGP and BGP_PRO
parameters.help_zh: 线路类型。常用取值包括 BGP 和 BGP_PRO
parameters.name: isp

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页行数，最大值为 100，默认值为 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The first filter key. Set the value to CreationStartTime, which specifies the start time of resource creation
parameters.help_zh: 第一个筛选键，取值为 CreationStartTime，表示资源创建的开始时间
parameters.name: filter_1_key

parameters.help_en: The second filter key. Set the value to CreationEndTime, which specifies the end time of resource creation
parameters.help_zh: 第二个筛选键，取值为 CreationEndTime，表示资源创建的结束时间
parameters.name: filter_2_key

parameters.help_en: The first filter value. Specify the time in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format
parameters.help_zh: 第一个筛选值，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ
parameters.name: filter_1_value

parameters.help_en: The second filter value. Specify the time in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format
parameters.help_zh: 第二个筛选值，采用 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ
parameters.name: filter_2_value

parameters.help_en: The lock type. Valid values: financial (locked due to overdue payment) and security (locked due to security reasons)
parameters.help_zh: 锁定类型。financial 表示欠费锁定，security 表示安全原因锁定
parameters.name: lock_reason

parameters.help_en: The type of the associated cloud service instance. Valid values: EcsInstance, SlbInstance, Nat, HaVip, NetworkInterface, and IpAddress
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的云产品实例类型，例如 EcsInstance、SlbInstance、Nat、HaVip、NetworkInterface 或 IpAddress
parameters.name: associated_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated cloud service instance
parameters.name: associated_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the EIP. Valid values: PostPaid (pay-as-you-go) and PrePaid (subscription)
parameters.help_zh: EIP 的付费模式。PostPaid 表示按量计费，PrePaid 表示包年包月
parameters.name: charge_type

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
